summary: Verified Pre-Book Review season picker fix. Season pill (pb-season-pill) now opens a menu (pb-season-menu) with SS27/FW27 by default plus a hint about archived; enabling pb-show-archived reveals FW26/SS26 with an 'Archived' badge. Selecting FW27 swaps drop tabs (Drop 1 OPEN·8 active, Drop 2 OPEN·3), updates hero to 'FW27 / Drop 1 OPEN' with 'Closes 12/15/2026' and '92 days left'; clicking pb-drop-drop2 swaps hero to 'FW27 / Drop 2'. FW26 (archived) shows all drops CLOSED, hero CLOSED pill with 'Closed 12/10/2025' and no 'days left'. Back to SS27 auto-selects the open Drop 3 (SS27 / Drop 3 OPEN, 7 days left). Exactly one pb-show-archived in DOM. Regression testids (pb-actions-btn, pb-more-btn, pb-preview-details, pb-demand-*, pb-sku-row-*, pb-subtab-orders, Setup → pb-new-prebook) all present. Backdrop click closes menu. No console errors.

issues: Kicker text is styled UPPERCASE via CSS but the DOM text is also literal uppercase (e.g. 'SEASON FW27 · DROP 1 OF 2'). Spec wording used 'Season FW27 · Drop 1 of 2'. Purely cosmetic; visual matches.

critical_code_review_comments: No data-testid on the hero title element (pb-hero-title referenced in tests but not present in /app/frontend/src/PreBookPage.tsx). Consider adding data-testid="pb-hero-title" to the H1/H2 for stable testing.

There are two duplicated buttons per drop (pb-drop-drop1..N) — one in the main .pb-drop-header (visible) and one in pb-drop-switcher (0×0 hidden). Strict selectors fail; recommend either removing the hidden duplicates or adding aria-hidden + unique testids to disambiguate.
Recharts container width/height=-1 warnings on dashboard render (pre-existing, unrelated to this change) — set explicit container min-width/height.
action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid="pb-hero-title" to the hero H1 for direct assertion.
(Optional) De-duplicate pb-drop-drop* buttons or hide the switcher variants from strict-mode testing (aria-hidden/no testid).
(Optional) Normalize kicker DOM text-case to sentence-case and rely on CSS for uppercase display.
